verdict.rationale: Hoppscotch's CLI (docs-8/21/31) supports running API tests and monitoring from a terminal/CI, but there is no evidence of declarative config management for API infrastructure (routes, gateways) or GitOps-style sync of collections into version control — in fact a GitHub feature request (comm-10) explicitly asks for git-based collection sync, indicating it isn't shipped. No OpenAPI/config-as-code export/import pipeline for CI-driven infra management is documented.
